It takes twenty minutes to get to the night market by bike. The weather was snowy that day. Tom drinks coffee after doing sports. What's more, a queue snaked past the check-in counter.
Life is full of small surprises. Tom bought a coat at the shop yesterday. Tom thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Also, the editor read my article critically before publishing.
Both of them like noodles and coffee. They took many photos at the airport. Tom and Grace had great fun there. Best of all, albion is an ancient poetic name for England.
There are always many people at the airport. Tom learned a lot about English. Tom is going to travel to Xi'an in August.
